title: Global uniform regularity for the 3D compressible MHD equations near a background magnetic field
summary: This paper resolves the global regularity problem for the three-dimensional compressible magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) equations in the three-dimensional whole space, in the presence of a background magnetic field. Motivated by geophysical applications, we consider an anisotropic compressible MHD system with weak dissipation in the $x_2$ and $x_3$ directions and small vertical magnetic diffusion.
